caveats: Portfolio inputs are fictional demo rows or local-private research inputs; only symbols are sent to public market-data providers.
Missing prices and returns remain unavailable and are never normalized to zero.
Performance, risk, factor, attribution, and stress outputs are historical or assumption-bound research, not recommendations.
No broker connection, rebalance instruction, position sizing, trade approval, autonomous action, or execution pathway is provided.

allocation.caveat: Allocation uses known valuations only; missing holdings are excluded and coverage is shown.

attribution.caveat: Residual separates geometric compounding from additive arithmetic contribution.
attribution.method: daily arithmetic contribution with geometric residual

correlation.caveat: Correlation is historical, unstable, and not causation.

data.disclosure: Portfolio analytics are historical or assumption-bound research calculations only. They are not investment advice, trading recommendations, position sizing, rebalancing instructions, trade approvals, broker actions, autonomous actions, or execution instructions.

factors.caveat: Proxy OLS exposures are descriptive, may be collinear, and do not establish causality.

exposures.caveat: Public asset proxy, not an institutional factor series.

holdings.caveat: Cash is defined at one base-currency unit.
holdings.name: USD Cash

performance.caveat: Historical delayed public or deterministic fixture prices; past performance does not guarantee future results.

money_weighted.reason: Dated external cash flows are not supplied.

time_weighted.reason: No external cash flows are present, so linked daily returns equal the simple period return.

performance.missing_data_policy: complete overlap; missing observations are never zero-filled

research_snapshot.caveat: The existing research guard pipeline validates a holdings-free source snapshot. Durable local research memory is Phase 5L.

risk.caveat: Historical estimates are sample-dependent and are not loss forecasts.

source_register.caveat: Only public symbols are sent to the market-data provider; quantities, costs, names and notes are not transmitted.

stress_tests.caveat: Observed portfolio replay within the selected source window; not a forecast.
